title: Best Man Cave Ever
description:
The Best Man Cave is walking distance  to Geodus soccer stadium. Broadway, Belmont University, Vanderbilt University, 12th South, Santa's Pub, The Gulch, and Belcourt Theater are also within walking diatance or a short Uber ride.  You’ll love our place because, when you are not out enjoying our city you can enjoy the hot tub, karaoke and other games.  Good for couples, solo adventurers, business travelers, families (with kids), or just visiting looking for a cool space to hang out. No parties.

The space
Our space is amazing. People are always blown away when they arrive. A lot of them find themselves  just hanging out when they are not enjoying our wonderful city because of all the things to do at our place instead of just hanging in a hotel room or another plain airbnb.

Guest access
Space is located in our basement, which has it own entrance and totally separate from the rest of the house. Once you arrive, we will show you how everything works so you can enjoy all the cool amenities  we have in the space. We have a keypad door knob so you don't have to worry about keeping up with keys.

Other things to note
Please be honest when booking. If you have extra people staying with you on your stay, I will be saying something to you, and I will be adjusting your rate.
